Adobe Illustrator API Advisor

Comparing the APIs for Illustrator 17.1.0 Build 273 and Illustrator 17.1.0 Build :
  • Class changes
    • Obsolete classes
    • New classes
    • Function member changes for common classes
    • Function pointer member changes for common classes
  • Struct changes
    • Obsolete structs
    • New structs
    • Function member changes for common structs
    • Function pointer member changes for common structs
  • File changes
    • Obsolete files
    • New files

Class changes

Obsolete classes

The following classes from have been removed from the API for Illustrator 17.1.0 Build , these classes existed in the API for Illustrator 17.1.0 Build 273:
  • ai::SuitePtr

New classes

The following classes have been added to the API for Illustrator 17.1.0 Build , these classes did not exist in the API for Illustrator 17.1.0 Build 273:

Function member changes for common classes

Functions that have changed in APIs common to both Illustrator 17.1.0 Build 273 and Illustrator 17.1.0 Build :
  • If a member listed under Illustrator 17.1.0 Build 273 isn't listed under Illustrator 17.1.0 Build then it has been removed from the API for Illustrator 17.1.0 Build .
  • If a member listed under Illustrator 17.1.0 Build isn't listed under Illustrator 17.1.0 Build 273 then it has been added to the API for Illustrator 17.1.0 Build .
